summary: Uni-Fuels Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K with a press release announcing first-quarter 2026 financial results and increased full-year revenue guidance to US$320M–US$340M. The filing shows a 64% YoY revenue increase to US$83.2M, gross profit up 85%, and marine fuel volumes rising 58%. This is a routine earnings update with no acquisition, divestiture, or other special-situation event disclosed. The company raised its outlook due to stronger-than-expected performance. No special-situation classification applies.
